claims.claim: The existing Product Source Pack persistence authority exposes an explicit typed ProductSourcePack rehydration API while preserving raw-dict deserialization and serialization compatibility.
Valid V1 manifests rehydrate to immutable value-equivalent ProductSourcePack values with exact ordered evidence semantics and timezone-aware observed_at values.
Typed rehydration rejects malformed or non-canonical persisted source-pack data without repair, inference, normalization, deduplication, or external work.
Round-trip behavior preserves plural ordered facts, media, conflicts, optional values, and deterministic value equality.
Existing source-pack V1 serialization and raw-dict deserialization compatibility remain intact without introducing another persistence format.
The restart-style no-network path reloads the canonical catalog and typed source packs, then constructs canonical profiles using existing public authorities and observation bindings.
The restart-style path continues through lexical retrieval and deterministic grounded-context construction and rendering without model, browser, network, or Drive work.
Existing catalog, codec, SQLite, profile, retrieval, and RAG authorities remain unchanged except for tests and documentation consuming their public APIs.
Focused coverage addresses typed decoding, strict failures, serialization compatibility, deterministic evidence ordering, and restart-style knowledge reconstruction.
The complete product_intelligence suite remains the M3 phase-transition regression gate rather than a mandatory gate for every later narrow repair.
M3 completion documentation records the completed scope, authority map, verification contract, candidate SHA, post-M3 deferrals, and M4 boundary without implementing M4 behavior.

M3 documentation classifies autonomous merge, ID allocation, migrations, authenticity, identity evolution, truth reconciliation, answer synthesis, and prompt generation as post-M3 deferred capabilities.
